text: This report requests that City Council deny the request for a permit to remove one privately owned tree located at 81 Walnut Avenue. The application indicates the reason for removal is that the tree is too large for the property and affects the enjoyment of their yard. The subject tree is a Colorado blue spruce (Picea pungens), measuring 42 cm in diameter. The Tree By-laws do not support the removal of this tree as it is healthy and maintainable.
City Council on December 15, 16 and 17, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council deny the request for a permit to remove one privately owned tree located at 81 Walnut Avenue.
